body: N-44 BUILT, not walked (26 Nov 2026, lead). The plain match (a video seen only by title, channel and length) now needs the TITLE: scoring.plain_title_ok, called by lean.rank for every upload that is not a structured song result. The bar is read WORD BY WORD in order (weakest word at least 0.7): the whole-string character ratio let 'Hurt' through for 'Hurt Me' (0.73) and two unrelated transliterated titles through at 0.61 ('Enta Wana' / 'Malekna Wassal'). A longer title that merely holds the wanted one is another song, except for long content (20 minutes or more) of the wanted length to the second (the recorded Surah Al-Baqarah recitation, an existing test). A short dense-script name is found only as a whole word. PROOF: on the REAL uploads of tests/fixtures/ytm 1,468 pairs of two different songs of one artist at the same length were taken before the change, 6 after: two spellings of one song (Kifak Inta/Enta, Shtatellak/Ishtatillak) and 'Pt. II' against 'Pt. 3' (a KNOWN LIMIT, pinned in the test: a title bar cannot tell a part number written two ways); seven mutants of the change are red. MATCHER_REVISION is NOT raised: the revision voids only a remembered 'not found' and never asked matched songs again (the item text said it would; corrected); a stricter rule leaves it. COST said by a test: a title that is only a bracketed phrase (Radiohead '(Nice Dream)') folds to nothing and is no longer taken on artist and length alone (the song path refused it already); the fix is in the fold (permanent keys), its own item. FOLLOW-UPS: N-52 (later): wrong uploads ALREADY kept have no re-ask path and the raw upload title is not stored: an audit of the kept videos, listed for the Host, never changed by itself. FINDING for the advisor: the structured bar MIN_TITLE_SIMILARITY 0.6 passes the same unrelated 0.609 pair when the artist matches; changing it changes what is found on every server, so it needs its own measurement.
